upstream_release_tag: v0.4.0 (811bdb1); source_commit includes the unreleased keyless search default batch
integration_status: core and node-sdk depend on vendor/nb-search-0.4.0-22c490b8.tgz
hosted_worker_api: Expose existing launcher injection and side-effect-free runWorker with readiness callback; no file admission or operation fingerprint changes.
tavily_api: Align every Tavily lane to the official API reference: /search and /extract use the Authorization Bearer header and documented body fields (time_range instead of the undocumented days, include_published_date, extract format/extract_depth), /crawl is added as a typed lane returning fetch-shaped page documents, and /research is added as the official create-then-poll async task lane. tavily.synthesis is retained as the documented /search include_answer answer. Provider adapter_version moved from 1 to 2 with the operation fingerprint change.
scope: Rebase the three small Kiki-specific patches onto nb-search 0.4.0 plus the upstream keyless search commit, rather than maintaining a fourth patch against 0.3.0. File scope identity and hosted-worker exports remain Kiki-only; Tavily official API parity remains a separate patch. Keyless DuckDuckGo search is opt-in because the public HTML endpoint challenged live requests; the zero-config default searches GitHub repositories and Context7 docs remains selectable.
apply: git apply vendor/nb-search-patches/canonical-target/source.patch, then hosted-worker.patch, then tavily-official.patch onto a clean 66aa4ac9ddc074cc24c8c8807d95095ba82782a7 checkout
replay_check: git apply --check and apply each patch in order onto a clean 66aa4ac9ddc074cc24c8c8807d95095ba82782a7 checkout; git write-tree after replay equals 22192459cc21c1675e6c82fe5fe7a5e88b8033a0, the patched build checkout tree
